limitations: CPU model predictions, not a hardware benchmark or mathematical stability proof
SLA boundary is observed grid only; no interpolation or extrapolation
Empirical service scaling is IID synthetic phase-batch/stage timing, not request-level variance
Low sample counts do not establish a reliable tail; all run counts remain visible

measurement_contract.closed_loop: client population is distinct from scheduler max_batch_size
measurement_contract.initial_state: fresh engine and empty measured cache per point/replication
measurement_contract.latency: original completed-request metrics; failed/timedout/unfinished veto SLO pass
measurement_contract.quantile: linear interpolation at (n-1)*q; pooled across all declared replications
measurement_contract.stability: finite observation only; completed drain plus declared backlog growth test
measurement_contract.throughput: original arrival-cohort completions / offered window, including drain
measurement_contract.window_completed_throughput: requests completed at or before window end / offered window
